name: Daniel Sierra
headline: Senior Product Engineer | TypeScript, React & Full Stack
summary: Senior Product Engineer and former Engineering Manager with 9+ years of experience building customer-facing digital products across frontend, mobile, and backend systems. Strong background in JavaScript/TypeScript and the React ecosystem, with experience owning product initiatives from problem definition through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration.

experience.title: Founder & Product Engineer
highlights: Designing and building digital products for the music industry, owning product and technical development end-to-end.
Building full-stack web applications across frontend experiences, backend services, database models, APIs, and deployment infrastructure.
Working primarily with TypeScript and modern web technologies to rapidly prototype, validate, and evolve product ideas.
Using AI-assisted engineering workflows with Claude Code and Cursor throughout discovery, implementation, testing, code review, and iteration.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer → Engineering Manager
highlights: Progressed from hands-on software engineering into engineering management within a high-growth European fintech.
Built and delivered customer-facing product experiences as part of cross-functional teams working closely with Product and Design.
Worked extensively within the JavaScript/TypeScript and React Native ecosystem on a large-scale consumer application.
Led a cross-functional engineering squad, supporting technical direction, delivery execution, and collaboration across Engineering, Product, and Design.

experience.title: React Native Developer
highlights: Built cross-platform iOS and Android applications from scratch using React Native and JavaScript.
Developed product experiences for a major US medical conference organiser, including event schedules, session discovery, and attendee engagement.
Delivered features across the full development lifecycle while collaborating remotely with a distributed engineering team.

experience.title: Android Developer
highlights: Built Android products for an event discovery and ticketing platform serving consumers, promoters, venues, and hospitality operators.
Delivered three applications covering event discovery, ticket purchases, promotional offers, venue operations, and bar payments.
Owned CI/CD infrastructure and application releases to Google Play.

experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Built mobile products using Android, Java, and Kotlin in early-stage and distributed product teams.
Delivered customer-facing functionality across the development lifecycle and collaborated directly with technical and business stakeholders.
